description: This file defines the AssistantMessageParser class, which processes chunks of assistant message text, maintains parser state, and extracts structured content blocks including text and tool usage, with support for streaming and partial content handling.

classes.name: AssistantMessageParser
classes.description: A parser class for processing assistant message chunks, maintaining state, and extracting structured content blocks with support for streaming and partial content.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of AssistantMessageParser and resets its state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state, clearing content blocks and internal indices.

methods.name: getContentBlocks
methods.description: Returns a shallow copy of the current content blocks.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a new chunk of text, updates parser state, and extracts content blocks, handling streaming content and partial data.

methods.name: finalizeContentBlocks
methods.description: Marks all partial content blocks as complete and trims text content after processing the last chunk.
